# odinex_load_balancer_type (Data Source)

Looks up a load balancer type by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_load_balancer_type" "lb11" {
  name = "lb11"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the load balancer type.
- `name` (String) Name of the load balancer type.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `max_connections` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent connections.
- `max_services` (Number) Maximum number of services.
- `max_targets` (Number) Maximum number of targets.
- `prices` (List of Object) Prices per location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Read-Only:

- `location` (String)
- `price_hourly_gross` (String)
- `price_hourly_net` (String)
- `price_monthly_gross` (String)
- `price_monthly_net` (String)
